description.value: Victoria Sushi is a Japanese restaurant situated on Wilson Street in the Esquimalt area of greater Victoria, serving sushi and Japanese cuisine. The restaurant supports online ordering, offering touring cyclists a convenient way to have a meal ready on arrival. It is a straightforward sit-down dining stop in a neighbourhood accessible from Victoria's network of urban cycling routes.
